about.intro_content: Prof. Zhuo-Wei Liu is Vice-President and Professor at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou. As an oncological urologist, he specialises in the surgical treatment of urinary tumours, particularly robotic and minimally invasive laparoscopic surgery.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Liu was one of the first surgeons in China to perform robot-assisted/laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer and ultra-expanded lymph node dissection for bladder cancer. He received the Outstanding Contribution Award for the highest volume of 3-4 level difficulty surgeries as chief professor at SYSUCC. He has led more than 10 research projects funded by the National Natural Science Foundation of China and the Guangdong Natural Science Foundation, published more than 40 first/corresponding-author articles, contributed to six academic works, and served as deputy chief editor of the journal Bladder Cancer. His recent research has been published in Cancer Cell, Nature Chemical Biology and Cell Reports Medicine.

faq.section_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Prof. Zhuo-Wei Liu

items.question: Does Prof. Zhuo-Wei Liu accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to bladder or testicular cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Liu's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Liu specialises in robotic and minimally invasive laparoscopic surgery for urologic cancer, with a particular focus on bladder cancer and testicular cancer.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Does Prof. Liu perform robotic surgery for testicular cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Liu was one of the first surgeons in China to perform robot-assisted retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular cancer.

items.question: Is Prof. Liu involved in research on bladder cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Liu has recently published bladder cancer research in leading journals including Cancer Cell, Nature Chemical Biology and Cell Reports Medicine.
